violations.description: Repository contains code and tests but has no CI configuration.
violations.evidence: search_code found no files matching '.github/*' indicating absence of GitHub Actions workflows.
violations.recommendation: Add a CI workflow (e.g., GitHub Actions) that runs the test suite on pushes and pull requests.

violations.description: Python project uses requirements.txt but no lockfile is committed.
violations.evidence: requirements.txt present but no Pipfile.lock, poetry.lock, or requirements.txt hash file found.
violations.recommendation: Commit a lockfile such as requirements.txt with hashes (pip freeze --require-hash) or use Poetry with poetry.lock to pin exact versions.

violations.description: Repository contains absolute machine-specific paths in deployment configuration files.
violations.evidence: deployment/nginx/microblog lines reference '/home/ubuntu/microblog/...', and supervisor configs use '/home/ubuntu/microblog/...'.
violations.recommendation: Replace absolute paths with relative paths or environment variables, and document configuration steps.

violations.description: Repository has no linter or formatter configuration.
violations.evidence: search_code did not find any linter configuration files such as .flake8, pyproject.toml with [tool.ruff], or similar.
violations.recommendation: Add a linter configuration (e.g., a .flake8 file or a pyproject.toml with [tool.ruff] settings) and integrate it into development and CI.
